name: Rock Hill High School NTHS Chapter
welcome: Find your next meeting, catch up on chapter news, and discover ways to serve our school and community.
about: The National Technical Honor Society recognizes students in career and technical education who demonstrate scholarship, leadership, and a commitment to service.
mission: Our chapter helps students put their technical skills to work through peer mentoring, hands-on projects, and service to the Lincoln community.
requirements: Be enrolled in a career and technical education pathway at Lincoln High School.
Meet the chapter’s academic and attendance expectations.
Complete the chapter application and ask a CTE teacher for a recommendation.
